result.description: Pay-as-you-go API platform selling SEO and business data: SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page, labs, domain analytics, content analysis, and more.
result.auth_detail: REST API accepts HTTP Basic only: API login plus an auto-generated API password (not the account password), sent in the Authorization header. OAuth 2.0 applies only to the HTTP MCP server transport, not the REST API.
result.access_detail: Free signup gives a $1 trial credit. Full use needs a $50 minimum top-up. Pricing is pay-as-you-go with no subscription, and balance never expires. Treated as trial-gated, since real usage means a prepaid deposit.
result.api_notes: REST/JSON with many API families: SERP, AI Optimization, Keywords Data, Domain Analytics, DataForSEO Labs, Backlinks, OnPage, Content Analysis, Merchant, App Data (plus Business Data per summary). Supports live and task-based endpoints. The auth page quote below comes from a model summary, not verbatim page text.
